task_completion.description: Configure Entrance and Lobby cameras for 24h 'always' mode, high quality, 25 FPS.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Camera settings or API request payloads showing 'Entrance Camera' and 'Lobby Camera' with recording type 'always', quality 'high', and fps '25' for all hours.

task_completion.description: Configure Parking Lot and Loading Dock cameras for business hours (08:00-22:00) at 15 FPS 'always' mode.

task_completion.visual_evidence: Schedule grid or API data for 'Parking Lot Camera' and 'Loading Dock Camera' showing 'motionOnly' recording from 22:00 to 08:00 at 10 FPS and 'normal' quality.

task_completion.description: Export the summary report to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., 'cat' or 'ls') or a text editor showing the content of /home/ga/recording_schedule_report.txt containing the configured schedules.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Nx Witness API/Service rather than just creating a fake text file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show HTTP requests (curl/Postman) or the Nx Witness Web UI, not just the final text file creation.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the task description into the report file without querying the system.
integrity.visual_evidence: Evidence of the agent fetching camera IDs or current settings from the API before writing the report.

integrity.description: The agent used the provided credentials (admin/Admin1234!) to access the system.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal logs or UI login screens showing the use of the specified username and password.
